insert into public.meal (slug,name,planned_date,status,pax,workflow_md,shared_prep_md,wine_pairing) values ($m$porchetta-dinner$m$,$m$Porchetta Dinner$m$,null,$m$backlog$m$::meal_status,3,$m$## Menu *3 pax + leftovers · 26 June 2026* 1. Porchetta with Salsa Verde 2. Crispy Roast Potatoes with Garlic, Lemon Zest & Flaky Salt 3. Charred Radicchio & Raw Fennel Salad 4. Warm Cannellini Beans with Garlic & Olive Oil 5. Chilled Orange with Olive Oil & Flaky Salt > *Portion note: Potatoes and beans together are substantial. For lighter appetites, omit one or the other — if retaining only one, keep the salad.* ## Critical Path > ***Critical path:** Rendering complete before crackling phase → crackling phase → 30-minute steam-free rest governs service. Do not delay slicing for side synchronisation. If crackling runs long, sacrifice potato crispness and bean temperature — protect crackling integrity and pork temperature.* ## T-Minus Timeline
TimeAction
T−24 to T−18Salt and roll porchetta. Tie every 2.5 cm. Salt skin. Air-dry uncovered on rack over tray in refrigerator.
T−2:45Begin rendering phase — oven 300°F / 150°C, middle rack, elevated wire rack over tray. (1 hr 45 min–2 hr 10 min)
T−2:00Reserve 45–60 ml / 3–4 tbsp rendered pork fat from drip tray for potatoes.
T−1:05Start beans on Burner 1. Make salsa verde. Char radicchio cut-side down in cast-iron on Burner 2 (60–90 sec). Slice fennel thinly.
T−0:55Parboil potatoes in well-salted water on Burner 2 — 12–14 min (outer layer yields, centre still firm).
T−0:52Raise oven to 475°F / 245°C. Crackling phase begins. (15–25 min)
T−0:42Drain potatoes. Rough surfaces aggressively in pot until shaggy. Hold uncovered on tray — 10 min surface drying before oven entry.
T−0:32Remove porchetta. Rest uncovered on elevated rack (30 min — do not tent). Potatoes enter oven immediately in reserved pork fat at 475°F / 245°C.
T−0:10Remove potatoes. Hold uncovered on rack.
T−0:04Zest and juice Lemon 2. Dress salad. Final seasoning on beans.
T−0:02Finish potatoes with lemon zest and flaky salt. Slice porchetta (remove twine; 1–1.5 cm slices).
T−0:00SERVE — Beans → Potatoes → Porchetta → Salsa verde → Salad. Window: 5–7 min. First failure if delayed: crackling softens.
**Critical path:** *Rendering must be complete before crackling phase — premature high heat is the primary failure mode. Once oven raises to 475°F at T−0:52, potatoes hold dry on tray. Porchetta 30-minute rest is non-negotiable; do not begin slicing before T−0:02.* ## Oven Sequencing & Heat Allocation **Oven sequencing:** *300°F / 150°C for rendering (Burner 1: beans; Burner 2: potato parboil from T−0:55, cast-iron radicchio char at T−1:05 clears well before parboil). Raise to 475°F / 245°C at T−0:52 for crackling. Oven remains at 475°F continuously through potato roast — no second transition. Potatoes enter the vacated oven at T−0:32 at full temperature.* ## Holding Chain
ComponentHold StrategyMax HoldDrift RiskCorrective Action
PorchettaElevated rack, uncovered, airflow underneath30 minCrackling softensReturn uncovered to 475°F / 245°C for 5–7 min before slicing
PotatoesUncovered on rack, room temp10–15 minCrust softens progressivelyNo recovery — serve as promptly as possible; never cover
BeansCovered on very low heat30 minTighten and thickenLoosen with 1–2 tbsp warm water before serving
SaladUndressed, refrigeratedUntil T−0:04Wilting if dressed earlyDress only at T−0:04 — never before
Salsa verdeRoom temperature, covered2 hoursHerb oxidation over timePrepare at T−1:05; use within 2 hours
## Sourcing Notes *Sourcing: One parsley bunch covers salsa verde (20 g). Lemon 1 zested at assembly (T−24); Lemon 2 zested and juiced at service (T−0:04) — do not zest in advance. Olive oil: ~190 ml total, one 500 ml bottle covers all dishes.* $m$,$m$**Lemons — 2 total:** prep differs by timing. Lemon 1: zest only → Porchetta paste (at roll assembly, T−24 to T−18). Lemon 2: zest of ½ → Potato finish; juice of ½ → Salad dressing. Both at service — zest and juice Lemon 2 together at T−0:04. **Garlic — 13 medium cloves + 1 small:** prep differs per dish, do not aggregate. 6 cloves → Porchetta paste (process with herbs) · 3 cloves → Potatoes (crush lightly, add halfway through roast) · 3 cloves → Beans (slice thin at T−1:05) · 1 small clove → Salsa verde (mince fine at T−1:05) $m$,null);

insert into public.dish (slug,name,protein,category,cuisine,difficulty,tags,occasion,status,source,governance_version,summary,method_md,servings,equipment,designed_unvalidated,nutrition_estimate) values ($m$porchetta-with-salsa-verde$m$,$m$Porchetta with Salsa Verde$m$,$m$Pork$m$,array[$m$Main$m$,$m$Sauce$m$]::text[],array[$m$Italian$m$]::text[],$m$Special$m$,array[$m$roast$m$,$m$crackling$m$,$m$dry-brine$m$,$m$overnight$m$,$m$two-stage-oven$m$,$m$salsa-verde$m$,$m$leftovers$m$]::text[],array[$m$Dinner party$m$,$m$Sunday dinner$m$]::text[],$m$designed$m$::dish_status,$m$Recovered from porchetta-dinner.docx, generated 26 June 2026$m$,null,$m$Skin-on pork belly rolled around a centre-cut loin with a fennel-herb paste, dry-brined 18–30 h, rendered at 300°F / 150°C then blistered at 475°F / 245°C to 142°F / 61°C, rested 30 min uncovered and served with a parsley-mint-caper salsa verde.$m$,$m$## Dish Overview Three-texture porchetta — shattered crackling, rendered belly fat, juicy loin centre — with mandatory salsa verde delivering the meal's primary acid balance and preventing palate fatigue across a full serving. ## Yield & Timing *Yield: 6–8 · Total: ~24 hr (incl. drying) · Active: ~35 min · Oven: 300°F → 475°F / 150°C → 245°C · Rest: 30 min* ## Prep Phase > *Critical path: full fat rendering before blistering phase. Overnight drying is non-negotiable. Salsa verde prepared at T−1:05 during rendering.* 1. **Belly:** Butterfly thicker areas to create an even slab ~1.5 cm / 0.6 in throughout. Make shallow horizontal cuts through thick interior sections only — do not cut through skin. Verify thickness end-to-end. Pat completely dry. 2. **Loin:** Trim silver skin. Orient loin so its grain runs parallel to the long axis of the roll — crosswise slicing at carving cuts across the grain of both belly and loin simultaneously. 3. **Salt cure:** Rub 18 g salt directly onto meat surfaces of both belly and loin. Rest 30–60 min refrigerated. 4. **Paste:** Combine fennel seed, peppercorns, garlic, rosemary, sage, lemon zest, chili flakes, olive oil. Process to a coarse paste. 5. **Assemble:** Rub paste over meat surfaces. Centre loin on belly. Roll tightly skin-side out. Tie every 2.5 cm / 1 in with butcher's twine. 6. **Dry-brine:** Rub skin with 8 g salt. Place uncovered on wire rack over tray in refrigerator 18–30 hours. Before roasting: skin must feel dry and tacky — not damp or cool. If moisture beads remain, continue drying. ## Active Cooking **Temper** Remove from refrigerator 60 min before roasting. Pat skin dry. Rub with neutral oil. Optional for weaker ovens: skewer perforations through skin every 2–3 cm / 1 in — do not deeply score. **Rendering Phase — 300°F / 150°C** Middle rack, elevated wire rack over tray. Cook until loin centre reaches 130°F / 54°C and fat beneath skin appears translucent rather than opaque white. Approx. 1 hr 45 min–2 hr 10 min. Secondary cue: fat feels softened rather than rubbery when pressed lightly with tongs — if still firm and opaque, continue. **Crackling Phase — 475°F / 245°C** Roast 15–25 min, rotating as needed. Pull when crackling is deeply blistered and audibly crisp when tapped, and loin centre reaches 142°F / 61°C. Carryover: final ~145°F / 63°C. Secondary cue: probe enters loin centre with light resistance like warm butter — springy or tight means continue. ## Holding & Assembly Rest uncovered on elevated wire rack over tray or board — 30 minutes. Do not tent. Trapped steam softens crackling; elevated airflow prevents underside steaming. If crackling softens during rest: return uncovered to 475°F / 245°C for 5–7 min before slicing. Salsa verde: finely chop parsley, mint, capers, garlic. Combine with vinegar, oil, salt, pepper. Hold at room temperature up to 2 hours. Remove twine. Slice 1–1.5 cm / 0.4–0.6 in. Serve immediately with salsa verde. ## Critical Control Points
SeverityFailure Mode & CueRecovery
CriticalWet skin entering oven — skin feels damp or cool rather than dry and tacky before roastingExtend uncovered refrigeration 6–12 h; unrecoverable once roasting begins
CriticalHigh heat before full rendering — fat layer opaque white and firm at start of crackling phaseReturn to 300°F / 150°C; continue until fat turns translucent and softens; retry crackling phase
MajorLoose rolling — visible gaps or movement inside roll when lifted before roastingRe-roll and re-tie tightly before roasting
MajorExcessive blistering — skin transitions to dark mahogany with acrid aroma during crackling phaseRemove immediately; lightly scrape isolated burnt spots if limited in area
## Adjustment Notes ***Adjust:** Increase salsa verde quantity if pork reads heavy; add additional salsa verde at the plate rather than applying citrus directly to the meat.* $m$,6,array[$m$butcher's twine$m$,$m$wire rack$m$,$m$tray$m$,$m$food processor$m$,$m$probe thermometer$m$,$m$tongs$m$,$m$skewer$m$]::text[],$m$[{"param": "Rendering phase", "designed_value": "300°F / 150°C, approx. 1 hr 45 min–2 hr 10 min, to loin centre 130°F / 54°C and translucent fat", "note": "Secondary cue: fat softened rather than rubbery when pressed with tongs."}, {"param": "Crackling phase", "designed_value": "475°F / 245°C, 15–25 min, pull at loin centre 142°F / 61°C", "note": "Carryover to final ~145°F / 63°C."}, {"param": "Dry-brine duration", "designed_value": "18–30 hours uncovered in refrigerator", "note": "Skin must feel dry and tacky before roasting; extend 6–12 h if damp."}, {"param": "Rest", "designed_value": "30 min uncovered on elevated rack", "note": "Max hold 30 min; return to 475°F / 245°C for 5–7 min if crackling softens."}, {"param": "Salsa verde hold", "designed_value": "Up to 2 hours at room temperature, covered", "note": "Herb oxidation over time."}]$m$::jsonb,null);

insert into public.dish (slug,name,protein,category,cuisine,difficulty,tags,occasion,status,source,governance_version,summary,method_md,servings,equipment,designed_unvalidated,nutrition_estimate) values ($m$porchetta-crispy-roast-potatoes$m$,$m$Crispy Roast Potatoes with Garlic, Lemon Zest & Flaky Salt$m$,null,array[$m$Side$m$]::text[],array[$m$Italian$m$,$m$British$m$]::text[],$m$Medium$m$,array[$m$roast$m$,$m$starch$m$,$m$parboil$m$,$m$pork-fat$m$]::text[],array[$m$Dinner party$m$,$m$Sunday dinner$m$]::text[],$m$designed$m$::dish_status,$m$Recovered from porchetta-dinner.docx, generated 26 June 2026$m$,null,$m$Parboiled and roughed Yukon Gold chunks roasted 20–30 min at 475°F / 245°C in fat reserved from the porchetta, with crushed garlic added halfway and finished with lemon zest and flaky salt.$m$,$m$## Dish Overview Crisp starch contrast cooked in reserved pork fat; lemon zest at finish adds aromatic brightness without introducing another sauce. ## Yield & Timing *with Garlic, Lemon Zest & Flaky Salt · Yield: 3–4 · Parboil: 12–14 min · Roast: 20–30 min at 475°F / 245°C* ## Prep Phase Cut into large chunks. SeverityFailure Mode & CueRecovery
